mac.prerequisites: Available quiet Mac, full run_tests.sh, universal build/ABI/load, 73-case exact replay with worker checks, mapped Stata fixtures and OLS/PPML Break

mac.quiet: No competing builds/tests or agent tools on Mac during timing; observe host activity before/after, preserve interruptions. No unrelated process termination.

protocol.stop: Any missing scientific prerequisite blocks dependent timing. No production change or extra timing after a failed/inconclusive required result; retain findings and seek direction. Integrate only if Mac qualification passes and SCC follow-up does not show an unresolved material regression.

mac.conditions: User made Mac available. No competing qualification builds, tests, transfers or agent tool workloads during timing, apart from output-only polling. Desktop/background activity observed at bookends; continuous idleness was not established. No release-performance claim.

perf.scope: Four whole-loader-process user-mode perf-stat runs in ABBA order. Includes harness input/output work outside native timings. Not function-specific or native instruction counts. User-only software-event zeros do not establish absent context switches/migrations.

analysis_method.ordinary: bench/time_exact.py compare(): median of within-pair ratios, 10000 bootstrap resamples, fixed seed739391, quantiles .025/.975; max(5%,1ms) allowance unchanged.
analysis_method.exact_sensitivity: For n ratios and tail alpha, choose smallest k with sum_{j=k}^n choose(n,j)/2^n <= alpha and return sorted_ratios[k-1]; report .025 and .025/(28*2), assuming independent identically distributed pairs. For n15 these select orders12 and15. Sensitivity never overrides the predeclared gate.
analysis_method.warmup: Mac and SCC standard repetition -1 excluded; SCC large repetition0 excluded prospectively. All warmup observations retained. Traced/counter runs never pooled with untraced timing.
analysis_method.interpretation: Paired median ratio and ratio of marginal medians are different statistics; report separately. Ordinary intervals do not make a familywise campaign-wide confidence claim. Phase clocks nest and separate medians need not sum.

operational_failures.outcome: Baseline and candidate builds passed; input generation rejected unsupported --memory option before producing a case. Focused replacement uses the generator's existing Fast default, omits optional observation outputs, and verifies the original case hash.

review.design: Independent analytical review supports faster preparation but no established causal explanation for later variability. Scheduling, placement/NUMA, cache effects and frequency are hypotheses.
review.validation: Independent high-effort review verified pairing, warmups, case counts, inference labels, lack of pooling, and the stop decision. No analysis blocker.

next_diagnostic_if_authorized: One bounded placement comparison using unchanged binaries, broad affinity versus four physical cores sharing a NUMA node/LLC, balanced pairs and consistent first-touch/memory policy. Existing phases and effective-frequency observations; no selection of the favorable placement to waive qualification. No such experiment has been run.
